headline: 2 injured as Shibir and JCD clash at DU's Shahidullah Hall
summary: The scuffle broke out during an investigation committee meeting over allegations of homosexual activity in a student room.
details: At least two people were injured after supporters of Islami Chhatra Shibir and Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal (JCD) engaged in a series of scuffles at Dhaka University's Dr Muhammad Shahidullah Hall today.

The clash broke out around noon inside and outside the hall provost's office, where an investigation committee was meeting over allegations that two guests in a student's room had engaged in homosexual activity.

Both organisations accused each other of entering the meeting and instigating the violence. Shibir claimed six to seven of its activists were assaulted, while JCD alleged Shibir leaders entered the meeting room first.
Dhaka University Proctor Md Israfil Ratan stated that a mobile team of assistant proctors was sent to the spot to mediate and calm the situation.
The proctor added that an investigation into the incident is currently underway, although the hall provost could not be reached for comment.

headline: Tk28 lakh in fake notes: Police arrest two suspects
summary: Law enforcement officials have apprehended two individuals in possession of counterfeit currency totaling 2.8 million Taka.
details: Police have arrested two individuals after recovering counterfeit currency worth Tk28 lakh from them.
The operation was conducted by law enforcement agencies to curb the circulation of fake notes in the market.
The suspects are currently under investigation to determine the source of the printing and distribution network of the counterfeit money.
